$schema_note: Zeptun configuration and CLI inventory (TOML and JSON documents accept the same keys; unknown keys are REJECTED).

language_and_build.compiler: Zig 0.16.0 (only requirement; no submodules, no vendored C libs except Wintun DLLs on Windows)
language_and_build.build: make | zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast | zig build cross | zig build android | make xcframework (scripts/make_xcframework.sh) | zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu + make wintun
language_and_build.feature_flags: -Dipv6 -Dsocks5 -Droute -Dicmp -Dfragments -Dsystem-stack -Duserspace-tcp -Dmobile -Dstrip (mobile defaults ON for ios/android targets: userspace stack only, no io_uring, no route module)
language_and_build.tests: zig build test | test-netns | test-ffi (tests/ffi_smoke.c -Wall -Wextra -Werror) | test-integration (189 end-to-end checks in namespaces) | bench

cli.flags_syntax: --flag value or --flag=value; --preset applied first, then -c/--config files, then remaining flags (later wins)
cli.flags_source: src/cli/args.zig L18-123 (usage text) + parser L161-413; docs/wiki/Command-line.md

socks5_client_behavior.methods: offers 0x00 (no auth), or 0x00+0x02 (username/password) when configured; Aether answers 0x00 either way
socks5_client_behavior.commands_used: CONNECT 0x01 (TCP), UDP ASSOCIATE 0x03 (udp_mode=udp), FWD_UDP 0x05 (udp_mode=tcp; NON-STANDARD, zeptun-specific)
socks5_client_behavior.udp_mode_udp: standard RFC 1928: associate with zero target, connect UDP socket to the reported relay (or udp_address override; unspecified relay address replaced by the server address), datagrams carry RSV/FRAG=0 headers
socks5_client_behavior.udp_mode_tcp: NON-STANDARD command 0x05 + [u16 len][u8 hdrlen][atyp+addr+port] frames on the control connection - implemented only by zeptun's own bench server; standard SOCKS5 servers (incl. Aether) reject it with 0x07
socks5_client_behavior.warm_pool: pool_size pre-connected, pre-authenticated and (udp mode) pre-associated connections per worker, recycled after pool_idle_ms; stats socks5_pool_hits/retries
socks5_client_behavior.pipeline: greeting+auth+request in one write (default without auth)
socks5_client_behavior.optimistic_data: first client bytes attached to the CONNECT request
socks5_client_behavior.domains: ATYP=domain supported for CONNECT and UDP headers (fake-IP mode dials by domain)
socks5_client_behavior.gso: UDP_SEGMENT towards the proxy and UDP_GRO back, per-datagram headers inside one sendmsg, through SOCKS5 UDP associations too

validation_rules: system/hybrid stack require build enable_system_stack; fd/external device forces userspace
fake_ip requires handler socks5 and at least one fake range
auto_redirect requires auto_route + TUN device + Linux + system stack
external device requires userspace stack and configured addresses for system/hybrid

platform_notes.linux: io_uring or epoll; rtnetlink policy rules 9000-9009, table 2022, upstream fwmark 0x2022; nftables auto-redirect; netns mode; reverse-path filter relaxed strict->loose; system/hybrid stacks available
platform_notes.android: VpnService fd (protect callback per socket) or /dev/tun with root (fwmark bit 0x200000 preserves netd selection; package rules via /data/system/packages.list); epoll; APP_PLATFORM android-24; 16 KB load-segment alignment (Android 15+)
platform_notes.windows: Wintun (vendored DLLs amd64/arm64/x86/arm; LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_APPLICATION_DIR; admin needed to create adapter); IOCP; IP Helper routes/DNS; upstream sockets IP_UNICAST_IF; strict route adds WFP session filters; adapter GUID pinning
platform_notes.macos: utun device; kqueue; split default routes, exclusions via previous gateway, upstream bound IP_BOUND_IF; route socket monitoring
platform_notes.ios: NEPacketTunnelProvider utun fd (find descriptor by walking open fds for utun*) or ZEPTUN_DEVICE_EXTERNAL with packet callbacks inside packetFlow; mobile preset for the extension memory limit; XCFramework slices: ios-arm64, ios-simulator-arm64/x86_64, macos
